Indian Navy Secures Tanker Amid Hormuz Tensions

The Indian Navy has secured the safe passage of the oil tanker Omega Trader, which carries 15 Indian crew members. The vessel is heading to Sikka port. This action comes amidst heightened tensions in the Strait of Hormuz, following attacks on three ships. The Strait of Hormuz is a critical route for India's energy imports, with nearly 40% of its crude oil, 60% of LNG, and 90% of LPG supplies passing through it before the conflict. India is also exploring diplomatic channels with Iran to free other tankers stuck near Hormuz.
